classification.difficultyReason: Identify successive inverse operations from supplied working, including fractions and grouped expressions.

content.prompt: Write down the operations done between each line of working out.

answer.worked:
Add $3$ to both sides, then divide both sides by $4$.
$$\begin{align*}4n-3&=17\\4n&=20\\n&=5\end{align*}$$

Subtract $6$ from both sides, then divide both sides by $5$.
$$\begin{align*}5d+6&=26\\5d&=20\\d&=4\end{align*}$$

Subtract $3$ from both sides, then divide both sides by $2$.
$$\begin{align*}3+2p&=33\\2p&=30\\p&=15\end{align*}$$

Subtract $5$ from both sides, then multiply both sides by $3$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{a}{3}+5&=9\\\frac{a}{3}&=4\\a&=12\end{align*}$$

Add $3$ to both sides, then multiply both sides by $2$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{h}{2}-3&=7\\\frac{h}{2}&=10\\h&=20\end{align*}$$

Multiply both sides by $5$, then subtract $3$ from both sides.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{k+3}{5}&=2\\k+3&=10\\k&=7\end{align*}$$

Multiply both sides by $4$, add $5$ to both sides, then divide both sides by $3$.
$$\begin{align*}\frac{3w-5}{4}&=7\\3w-5&=28\\3w&=33\\w&=11\end{align*}$$

Divide both sides by $3$, add $4$ to both sides, then divide both sides by $2$.
$$\begin{align*}3(2b-4)&=30\\2b-4&=10\\2b&=14\\b&=7\end{align*}$$
